name: Orbital station window
desc: a window on a station in orbit, for looking down at home and being far from it
tags: orbital station window, curved earth below through the glass, thin blue atmosphere on the limb, black space and stars, white cloud swirls over ocean, padded module interior, handrails, equipment panels with indicator lights, cables and stowage bags
prose: a window in an orbital station looking down on the curved earth, the thin blue line of atmosphere along its limb against black space, cloud swirling over the ocean below, with the padded module interior, handrails and lit equipment panels framing the view
note: Renders as an aeroplane porthole with flat blue sky outside. What buys orbit is the CURVE of the earth across frame, the thin atmosphere line at the limb, and black sky with stars above it. Keep the interior nouns (handrails, panels, stowage bags) in shot or you get a plain photograph of a planet with no room around it and nowhere for a character to stand.
